key_findings: Synaptamide relieved SNI-induced thermal allodynia, mechanical hyperalgesia and hippocampus-dependent memory deficits in mice.
Synaptamide reversed SNI-induced hippocampal microglial activation (Iba-1, CD86), loss of NR1 and PSD-95, dendritic spine loss, impaired neurogenesis and LTP impairment.
